raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With expert parallelism, the online Quark MXFP4 loader can receive a nonlocal expert after finishing its local weights. The underlying loader correctly copies nothing, but the wrapper compares the accumulated BF16 element count with the now-packed parameter size and raises an assertion. This affects online-quantized MoE loading, including the Qwen3.5 MTP path on ROCm.

## Modifications

Return after a zero-copy load, following weight-name validation. Local copies retain the existing completion and quantization logic. Add CPU regressions for both packed weight parameters and invalid names.

## Accuracy Tests

CPU test file: `test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_quark_w4a4_mxfp4_moe.py` 5 passed. The two new no-copy cases fail without the fix; the invalid-name case rejects an incorrectly placed early return.

On an MI355X with real AITER quantization, compared base `9301ca37` with the three-line fix: six loading sequences and sixteen controls per version passed the expected base-failure/head-success checks. Packed weights and scales matched direct-quantization references and corresponding EP1/EP2 expert fixtures. Invalid names and duplicate local loads retained their expected errors.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: the change handles a no-copy call during weight loading; no inference-speed claim.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

_Disclosure: Found by [Hyperloom](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Hyperloom) session analysis, reviewed and validated by human._

@@ -1,17 +1,8 @@
-"""Unit tests for the Quark W4A4 MXFP4 MoE clamped-SwiGLU plumbing.
-
-CPU-only, no model loading and no aiter/ROCm dependency: they exercise the
-pure-Python control flow in ``QuarkW4A4MXFp4MoE.create_moe_runner`` and
-``apply_weights`` that decides whether the AITER MoE runner is driven on the
-clamped-SwiGLU path (``activation="swiglu"`` + ``swiglu_limit``) or the plain
-SiLU path. See the regression these guard against: clamped-SwiGLU MXFP4
-checkpoints (e.g. MiniMax-M3) declare ``activation="silu"`` + a
-``gemm1_clamp_limit``, and without this plumbing the experts silently run plain
-SiLU and emit garbage.
-"""
+"""CPU regression tests for Quark MXFP4 MoE loading and runner plumbing."""
 
 import sys
 from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
 
 import pytest
 import torch
@@ -21,6 +12,7 @@
     QuarkW4A4MXFp4MoE,
 )
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
 
 register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
 
@@ -88,5 +80,52 @@ def test_apply_weights_defaults_swiglu_limit_zero_without_clamp(monkeypatch):
     assert store["quant_info"].swiglu_limit == 0.0
 
 
+class TestOnlineWeightLoader(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_nonlocal_w13_after_quantization(self):
+        self._check_no_copy("w13")
+
+    def test_nonlocal_w2_after_quantization(self):
+        self._check_no_copy("w2")
+
+    def test_invalid_weight_name(self):
+        self._check_no_copy("invalid")
+
+    def _check_no_copy(self, name):
+        packed = torch.nn.Parameter(
+            torch.ones(1, 2, 2, dtype=torch.uint8), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        layer = SimpleNamespace(
+            w13_weight=packed,
+            w2_weight=packed,
+            _w13_loaded_numel=8,
+            _w2_loaded_numel=8,
+            _load_device=torch.device("cpu"),
+        )
+        original_loader = MagicMock()
+        loader = _make_scheme().get_online_weight_loader(layer, original_loader)
+        args = (
+            packed,
+            torch.ones(2, 4),
+            f"{name}_weight",
+            "w2" if name == "w2" else "w1",
+            1,
+        )
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.srt.layers.quantization.quark.schemes.quark_w4a4_mxfp4_moe.dynamic_mxfp4_quant"
+        ) as quantize:
+            if name == "invalid":
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Expected w13 or w2"):
+                    loader(*args)
+            else:
+                loader(*args)
+            quantize.assert_not_called()
+        original_loader.assert_called_once()
+        self.assertIs(layer.w13_weight, packed)
+        self.assertIs(layer.w2_weight, packed)
+        self.assertEqual(layer._w13_loaded_numel, 8)
+        self.assertEqual(layer._w2_loaded_numel, 8)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(packed, torch.ones_like(packed))
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
